messages:
maria.g: Heads-up — we're rolling schema v3 for customer-facing audit events next week. Need alignment on S3 export, webhook format, and Datadog/SIEM mappings.

ben: What are the breaking changes from v2 we should call out to customers?

maria.g: Biggest diffs: canonicalized actor identity (now includes role_id + ephemeral_session_id), standardized resource path, and a new `outcome` enum (success, failure, denied, timed_out). Also small renames: `user` => `initiator`.

alex.k: For webhooks we must keep HMAC header stable. plan: `X-Redwood-Signature: sha256=<hex>` and include `X-Redwood-Idempotency` per-request. Retries should be idempotent.

tanvi: For S3 export, customers asked for envelope encryption using their KMS. We need clear docs on envelope format and the headers we set. Suggestion: object metadata `x-amz-meta-redwood-kms-key-id` and `x-amz-meta-redwood-envelope-v1` to indicate envelope.

sec-bot: FYI vulnerability note: dependency `aws-s3-exporter` v1.7 transitively uses `http-client` with CVE-2025-1234. Patch to v1.8 fixed signing edge-case; recommend bump before wide rollout.

ben: Good call. If we bump SDK, double-check S3 object ACL defaults so we don't accidentally change visibility. Also confirm KMS grants for cross-account decrypt.

maria.g: Agreed. For Datadog/SIEM mapping, we want a minimal recommended mapping for initial onboarding: `event_id`, `timestamp`, `initiator.id`, `initiator.email`, `initiator.role_id`, `resource.type`, `resource.id`, `action`, `outcome`, `ip`, `user_agent`, `request_id`. We'll provide a sample grok/json pipeline.

alex.k: Sample payload (will send compact example for customers to validate):
```json
{"event_id":"evt_01F3X1","timestamp":"2025-11-14T22:15:03Z","initiator":{"id":"usr_77","email":"ops@acme.com","role_id":"role_admin"},"resource":{"type":"dedicated_pool","id":"pool-12"},"action":"dedicated.scale","outcome":"success","ip":"3.120.22.5","user_agent":"redwood-api/1.2","request_id":"req_20251114_22_15_03"}
```

tanvi: For webhook consumers who want Splunk/Datadog-friendly fields, we should also include `schema_version":"v3"` at the top-level and a short `event_summary` string. Makes routing easier.

jordan: On delivery semantics — suggest: 3 retries with exponential backoff (1s, 5s, 20s), then move to durable queue and notify customer with a signed link to replay. Ops should be able to requeue.

ops-bot: requeue API: `POST /internal/audit/replay {\"object_key\":\"s3://audit-bucket/2025/11/14/evt_01F3X1.json\" }` (auth required).

maria.g: For onboarding checklist to share with customers: 
- Confirm KMS key ARN and whether Redwood should envelope with customer key (yes/no).
- Webhook endpoint + HMAC secret exchange (we provide one-time token).
- Confirm desired delivery: webhook realtime OR S3 batch OR both.
- Map fields they need for SIEM/Datadog and sample event validation.

ben: Also include RBAC change audit entries: we need new event types `rbac.role.create`, `rbac.role.update`, `rbac.role.bind` and ensure we log previous and new role snapshots. Those must be included in exports and obey pii redaction policy.

tanvi: On pii: we will redact `initiator.email` only if tenant requests redaction; otherwise include. Add `pii_masked: true/false` flag in payload so customers know.

sec-bot: Incident triage note: If we detect a replay flood (more than 1000 replays/min from a customer), auto-rate-limit replays and create a Sev-3 ticket.

maria.g: Ops, confirm S3 object metadata we set for KMS + schema version. Ops: can you confirm default TTL for audit S3 export?

ops-bot: Default retention is 90 days for standard tier. We can configure per-tenant up to 7 years (enterprise). Metadata we'll add: `x-redwood-schema=v3`, `x-redwood-kms-enc=envelope-v1`, `x-redwood-tenant=tenant_1234`.

alex.k: Webhook receivers: provide sample verification snippet in multiple languages. e.g., Node: `crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(body).digest('hex')` compare against header.

maria.g: Customer validation step for onboarding: they must POST a sample event to our validation endpoint and we'll return a 200 with `validation_status: pass|warn|fail` plus reasons. We'll include a small CLI check: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/audit/validate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d @sample_event.json`

ben: Anything about SLA? For Dedicated customers we support 99.95% delivery attempt uptime; document that delivery attempts are best-effort and subject to retry policies and customer endpoint availability.

tanvi: Also note: when we rotate webhook signing keys, we include `X-Redwood-Signature-Alg: sha256` and provide overlapping key windows for 12 hours. Document rolling key rotation procedure.

maria.g: Action items: 
- @alex.k: publish webhook verification snippets + HMAC header spec.
- @tanvi: finalize S3 envelope metadata + KMS grant docs.
- @ben: add RBAC event type defs and redaction policy.
- @ops-bot: confirm retention and requeue API docs.
- @jordan: patch `aws-s3-exporter` dep to v1.8 and run canary.

alex.k: I'll put PRs in for the snippets and a sample `validate` endpoint stub. :thumbsup:

jordan: Patch queued, running canary on staging now. No regressions so far. :eyes:

maria.g: Great — I'll draft the customer onboarding checklist and sample payloads. Will post a draft RFC in #eng-security-docs tomorrow.

sec-bot: Recorded action items to ticket SEC-2025-034.

maria.g: Thanks all. If anyone finds edge-cases for SIEM mappings (nested arrays, long resource paths) drop them here.

ben: One more — include `resource.hierarchy` array for breadcrumbs (org > project > cluster). Helps correlation in Splunk.

maria.g: Good idea. I'll add that to v3 schema notes. :shipit:
